mode: DigitalHut Functional Rank Boost Cluster Push
purpose: Stage the first reasonable cluster dumps that can boost DigitalHut where competitors have sales pages but not built observatory functionality.
guardrail: No public flood. These clusters are staged into the system and respect the 4 blog posts per 24 hours whiteboard cap until live rank/behavior proof refreshes.

audienceConclusion.read: The current audience appears visual-proof curious before it is search-panel or market-panel active.
evidence: 62 GLB previews against 225 page views (27.6% of page views) shows the 3D proof lane is the strongest visible behavior.
14 blog views (6.2% of page views) shows proof pages have some traction but need stronger route/source connection.
0 search interactions means the system should create clearer human-intent entry points before expecting typed search behavior.
0 market opens means market rank clusters should stay staged until the market panel earns behavior.
2 podcast interrupts means podcast/source authority is present but still a support lane, not the lead lane.
audienceRequestInference: Show me useful proof, not a sales landing page.
Explain what the video/topic is about without making me search manually.
Give me proof routes and backlinks that make the presentation credible.

clusters.audienceNeed: Visitors are proving they want inspectable 3D/GLB context, not just a company asking for money.
clusters.competitorGap: Most small and mid-size companies have front-facing service pages, image galleries, or forms, but no live 3D proof route tied to video/source context.
keywords: 3d model proof instead of landing page
clusters.systemPush: Lead with GLB/source proof because last-known behavior favors GLB previews.

clusters.audienceNeed: Visitors need the system to explain a video/topic with sources, backlinks, and route proof before they trust the analytics.
clusters.competitorGap: Most media pages embed video or summarize it, but do not combine video, source links, backlink proof, GLB context, podcast/source moments, and measured behavior.
keywords: what am i watching video backlinks
viral video explained with proof routes
clusters.systemPush: Attach every entertainment/video cluster to backlinks and watch/blog proof before public promotion.

clusters.audienceNeed: Normal users need useful local decisions: lunch, groceries, repairs, tickets, rides, and reviews with source proof.
clusters.competitorGap: Most local companies and directories show listings, reviews, or booking forms, but do not build a source-backed visual decision map.
keywords: best lunch near me visual source map
local service source backed visual guide
clusters.systemPush: Use everyday language first because search is quiet and typed behavior needs clearer entry points.

clusters.audienceNeed: Technical visitors need evidence that the system is infrastructure-backed, not a visual demo.
clusters.competitorGap: Many developer/research pages explain features, but do not show route proof, cloud readiness, source events, GLB proof, and measurement contracts together.
keywords: programmer research hub with source links
clusters.systemPush: Use build/system proof to show DigitalHut has real infrastructure behind the media presentation.

systemCombinationPush: FireCuda stores the four cluster dumps, rank targets, filler rejects, and backlink candidates.
Supabase waits for route, source, GLB, podcast, search, blog, and category receipts before promotion.
Google Cloud supports media/source metadata enrichment when allowed by API/source rules.
Vercel serves only stable proof packets and route metadata after build/deploy proof.
Codex reasoning compares the audience read against the cluster map and keeps filler out.
nextSystemMove: Run a 15-minute standby so the whole system refreshes around these four functionality-first rank clusters, then review live-proof blockers before any publish/deploy step.
